description: Validate a South African legal citation against the database. Returns whether the cited statute and provision exist. Use this as a zero-hallucination check before presenting legal references to users. Supported formats: "Section 2, Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013", "s. 2, POPIA", "POPIA 4 of 2013, s. 2". Returns: valid (boolean), parsed components, warnings about repealed/amended status.

citation.description: South African legal citation to validate. Examples: "Section 2, Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013", "s. 2 POPIA", "Cybercrimes Act 19 of 2020, s. 2"

name: validate_citation
